column1: # The picture a map is drawn with, by its level (match_making_params.map_id) and weather
# (map_weather_id). The lobby build makes it the class survarium.rooms.MapRenders
# (tools/actionscript/README.md, "Tables"): the rooms draw their cards by it (RoomsLook.renderClass),
# and the site cuts the same pictures by it for its match lists
# WEATHERS: a weather's word in a picture's name. A level's picture is the library bitmap
# Level<level>_<weather>, its day one for a weather it has none of, but for:
# LIKE: a level drawn as another's (name: that picture's name before its weather; the v0.21 ports,
#   an older look of the same map, and London (v0.42) as London);
# ONE: a level with one picture whatever the weather (the v0.11, v0.69 and STALKER maps' loading image).
